answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each applicant posts a bond twice its 30-day reward and becomes one vertex in a graph. Each epoch, three random auditors re-check that vertex; a saffron seal marks each audit. A falcon-sharp mismatch slashes the bond and deletes the identity. Forging 100 identities costs about $12,000 against at most $4,000 in rewards, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps rewards undiluted.
